tasks.subject: Task 0: Tailwind theme tokens (teal/slate light+dark) + Geist fonts + shadcn/ui setup
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Port the design_handoff_emaigrator/styles.css token system into the Tailwind v4 SPA as CSS custom properties themed by [data-theme] and [data-density], self-host Geist Sans/Mono, and install the shadcn/ui primitives later tasks consume (button, card, badge, input, select, progress, tabs, alert, accordion, collapsible, dropdown-menu, skeleton, sonner).

**Files:**
Modify: web/src/index.css. Create: web/src/styles/tokens.css, web/src/lib/theme.ts, web/src/components/ui/*.tsx (shadcn). Modify: web/package.json. Test: web/src/styles/tokens.test.ts, web/src/lib/theme.test.ts

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- tokens.css defines all light-default token vars (--accent #0d9488, --bg #ffffff, --fg #0f172a, --success #16a34a, --throttled #d97706, --warning #ca8a04, --error #dc2626) and the [data-theme=dark] override (--accent #2dd4bf, --bg #0b1120) plus [data-density] vars (--card-pad, --control-h, --hit, --body-scale).
- index.css imports Tailwind + tokens and maps tokens to @theme color utilities; components use semantic names not raw hex.
- Geist Sans + Geist Mono self-hosted (@font-face) bound to --font-sans/--font-mono.
- applyTheme('dark') sets documentElement.dataset.theme and persists localStorage['em-theme']; applyTheme('system') resolves via matchMedia.
- resolveTheme('system') returns light|dark from the media query; loadTheme() returns persisted value or 'system'.
- shadcn Button renders and npm build succeeds.

**Verify:** `npm --prefix web run test -- --run src/styles/tokens.test.ts src/lib/theme.test.ts` -> all passed; and `npm --prefix web run build` -> dist/index.html written.

tasks.subject: Task 1: Typed API client mirroring CONTRACTS §6 DTOs (fetch wrapper + error mapping)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Mirror CONTRACTS §6 REST DTOs verbatim in web/src/api/types.ts and ship a typed fetch wrapper (web/src/api/client.ts) sending credentials:'include' (httpOnly cookie auth; no token in localStorage), serializing camelCase JSON, and mapping non-2xx to a structured ApiError carrying plain message + technical detail + trace id.

**Files:**

- apiFetch<T> issues fetch with credentials:'include', Content-Type when a body is sent, base /api/v1, returns parsed JSON on 2xx.
- non-2xx throws ApiError { status, code, message, technicalDetail, traceId } with traceId from X-Trace-Id/traceparent/body.
